app_info.subtitle: Research and monitor news
app_info.description: Perigon helps users find and summarize news, research people, companies, journalists, and publishers, and compare coverage trends. Users can manage news monitors, watchlists, and publisher groups, read signal briefings, and export and analyze signal events with charts in an analysis workspace. Available data and tools depend on account permissions and the connected tool selection.

test_cases.description: Search recent news and handle empty results.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find English-language articles about semiconductor export controls from the past seven days. If there are no matches, say so.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching articles with titles, dates, sources, and links, or clearly reports no matches without inventing coverage.

test_cases.description: Compare news volume and sentiment over the same period.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show daily article counts and average sentiment for electric vehicles over the past month.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns daily counts and sentiment using matching filters and dates, with any unavailable data clearly identified.

test_cases.description: Create a draft monitor without starting processing.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a draft EVENT monitor called Semiconductor executive departures to track executive departures at semiconductor companies. Extract company, executive, and role. Do not activate it or configure notifications.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a DRAFT monitor with the requested objective, article filters, and extraction schema, and confirms that processing has not started.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find my watchlist named EV competitors and replace its company list with Tesla and Rivian. Keep its other settings.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the intended watchlist, asks for clarification if ambiguous, and replaces only its company list as requested.

test_cases.description: Export and chart signal data in an analysis workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find my Product recalls signal, check its type, and, if it is EVENT or MENTIONS, export this month’s events to a new file and show a chart of counts by day. If it is TOPIC, explain that event export is unavailable.
test_cases.tools_triggered: signal_insights_search_signals, signal_insights_read_signal, signal_insights_create_workspace, signal_insights_export_events, signal_insights_execute_code, signal_insights_preview_chart
test_cases.expected_output: Checks the signal classification; for EVENT or MENTIONS, creates a workspace, exports to a fresh filename, and displays a daily-count chart, while TOPIC or empty results receive an accurate explanation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for personal calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Move my dentist appointment to next Tuesday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot access or edit personal calendars.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for direct journalist outreach.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email a pitch to this journalist at the address I provide.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not send ad hoc outreach emails.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for editing publisher content.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Replace the headline on this newspaper’s website with my new headline.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot edit or publish articles on external news websites.
